feeding_claim.verbatim: sourced from Angus cattle that graze freely on rich, nutritious grasslands.

resold_note: Also sells chicken, duck and seafood from an unnamed sourced freezer selection.
notes: AGW lists it as Animal Welfare Approved for beef (town North Canaan); farm site says Canaan. Product pages call the beef grass-fed and pasture-raised with no finishing statement. Ships by FedEx on Tuesdays to CT, MA, NY, NJ, NH, VT, southern Maine and eastern Pennsylvania; homepage also says Rhode Island, which the shipping policy omits. Site shows a Certified Humane badge but not checked on that certifier, so not added. Verifier to confirm pork is raised on the farm and whether chicken or duck are farm-raised.
